official_authority: US Department of Justice Office of Information Policy
rule_or_entry: Typical/all-other requester: first two search hours and first 100 copied pages; fee estimate and narrowing process; fee waiver public-interest test
verified_operational_meaning: The ordinary noncommercial fallback is not the same as educational/scientific status.
design_consequence: Use actual requester category; state a fee cap and ask for an estimate before work beyond the cap.
boundary: Do not assert that any project member automatically qualifies for a waiver.

official_authority: US Department of Justice Office of Information Policy
rule_or_entry: Educational/noncommercial scientific/news-media requesters pay duplication beyond first 100 pages and are not charged search fees; all-other requesters receive first two hours search plus first 100 pages duplication
verified_operational_meaning: Fee categories depend on requester identity and purpose; fee waiver is separate.
design_consequence: Do not label a company or unaffiliated individual educational/scientific merely because the subject is research.
boundary: This is DOJ rulemaking guidance; live component handling may require proof and category confirmation.

official_authority: WHS OSW/JS FOIA Requester Service Center
rule_or_entry: Electronic submission preferred; mail/fax alternatives; full contact details, record description and maximum fee required; waiver points to 32 CFR 286.28(d)
verified_operational_meaning: WHS is a viable initial route for records in OSW/JS control, including its own award-management records.
design_consequence: Ask for referral or custody notice if responsive material lies with another component.
boundary: WHS does not process all DoD records.

official_authority: WHS OSW/JS FOIA Requester Service Center
rule_or_entry: Advance payment may be sought for assessable fees above USD 250 from requesters without established payment history; electronic or mail submission
verified_operational_meaning: A USD 50 cap with consultation/narrowing instruction is a low-risk initial setting.
design_consequence: Do not claim a component-wide zero-fee threshold from this page.
boundary: Fee estimate is not a refusal or a substantive record result.

rule_or_entry: Direct request to command that generated/maintains records where known; require identity/contact, specific description, fee willingness and waiver basis if applicable
verified_operational_meaning: MCIPAC micro-request should name the installation/custodian and one fiscal period, rather than seek a generic global MCCS account.
design_consequence: Use real-time command routing and preserve the selected route.
boundary: The exact portal state may change; verify before sending.

official_authority: Department of the Air Force FOIA Public Access Link
rule_or_entry: PAL is for FOIA requests where Air Force owns the record; registration and status functions shown
verified_operational_meaning: USAF has a usable official electronic entry if later evidence points to an Air Force custodian.
design_consequence: It is not a fallback for WHS or MCIPAC records without a custody basis.
boundary: No USAF request is designed or sent in this pilot.

rule_or_entry: Anyone may request; local-defense-bureau records are addressed to the relevant bureau head; no telephone/fax/email filing; request count generally follows document/custodian/year; fee JPY300 per administrative document
verified_operational_meaning: Japan pilot must be one fiscal year and one confirmed custodian/document first.
design_consequence: Pre-filing consultation is not a formal request.
boundary: Electronic delivery is not promised merely because a record is electronic.

rule_or_entry: Request form with JPY300 revenue stamp per item; counter or postal filing; written decision ordinarily within 30 days, extendable; partial non-disclosure categories listed
verified_operational_meaning: Save the formal decision, extension, correction request and stated non-disclosure basis as separate procedural records.
design_consequence: A denial/partial disclosure records the response of this process, not the real-world absence of expenditure.
boundary: The page is Defense Ministry procedure; custodian-specific outcomes remain unknown.

rule_or_entry: Provides Okinawa form, example, e-Gov file-management-register link, information-disclosure desk, phone and address
verified_operational_meaning: Use the bureau desk only to identify custodian, exact title, count and copying route before a paper/counter request.
design_consequence: Request is addressed to 沖縄防衛局長 for its held documents.
boundary: Phone call cannot substitute for formal filing.

rule_or_entry: Administrative Information Disclosure Act official law text and downloadable formats
verified_operational_meaning: The law is the governing statutory basis; MOD pages operationalize its intake and fee rules.
design_consequence: Retain electronic-record wording separately from mode of submitting a request.
boundary: Do not infer a duty to create new compilations from the right to request held records.
